items.t: New Street's Ferragu Sees Strong Case to Buy Nvidia Shares Ahead of Earnings
items.d: Pierre Ferragu of New Street Research maintains a buy rating on Nvidia shares and says the recent selloff strengthens the case to buy. He says the resignation of CEO Jensen Huang won't affect near-term earnings. Ferragu speaks on "Bloomberg Surveillance." (Source: Bloomberg)

items.t: Read Jensen Huang’s Statement Offering a Return as Nvidia CEO

De Nvidia a los humanoides: EE.UU. vs. China: en la carrera por la IA
items.d: Tanto EE.UU. como China ven en la inteligencia artificial el nuevo epicentro de su rivalidad económica. El presidente estadounidense, Donald Trump, ha declarado que “quien gane en IA, gana”. La cuestión es si ambas potencias pueden dejar de lado sus diferencias y cooperar para crear un entorno seguro y sostenible para el desarrollo de esta tecnología.

items.d: 젠슨 황 전 엔비디아 최고경영자(CEO)의 퇴진으로 메모리 반도체 수요가 위축될 수 있다는 우려가 일각에서 제기되지만 실제로는 그렇지 않을 것이라는 전망이 나왔다. 장기적으로 ‘메모리’와 ‘로직 반도체’의 결합이 강화되고 고객 맞춤형 고부가가치 제품이 확대되면서 삼성전자와 SK하이닉스 등 메모리 업체들의 영향력이 오히려 커지고, 특히 두 반도체를 모두 생산할 수 있는 삼성전자에는 새로운 기회가 될 수 있다는 분석이다. 17일 시장조사업체 카운터포인트리서치에 따르면 황 전 CEO의 퇴진이 향후 18∼24개월간 AI 반도체 공급망에 미칠 영향은 제한적일 것으로 점쳐졌다. 엔비디아의 블랙웰에서 베라 루빈으로 이어지는 제품 개발 일정이 이미 확정돼 있기 때문이다.  황 전 CEO의 퇴진은 엔비디아의 독주 체제에도

items.t: Jensen Huang says he would be ‘honored’ if asked to return as Nvidia CEO
items.d: Jensen Huang said Tuesday that he would be “honored” to return to his job as CEO of Nvidia if the chip giant’s board of directors decided to bring him back.
items.fullText: Corporations Jensen Huang says he would be ‘honored’ to return as Nvidia’s CEO The statement is Huang’s first since resigning from Nvidia amid reports of an extramarital relationship with a woman believed to be a Chinese spy. Listen to this article with a free profile 00:00 00:00 Jensen Huang agrees to appear for House interview on Nvidia in December 00:37 Get more news Live on Share Add NBC News to Google Nov. 17, 2026, 10:29 AM EST / Updated Nov. 17, 2026, 11:23 AM EST By Rob Wile and Brennan Leach Jensen Huang said Tuesday that he would be “honored” to return to his job as CEO of Nvidia if the chip giant’s board of directors decided to bring him back. In a statement posted to X , Huang, who resigned as CEO last week over allegations of extramarital affairs, including one with a suspected Chinese spy, said he would welcome the opportunity to retake the reins of the company he co-founded in 1993. “Since my departure, I’ve seen an outpouring of calls from Nvidia’s employees, investors, business partners, and customers for me to return as CEO,” Huang said in a short statement. “If the Board of Directors decides that my return is in the best interest of our shareholders, our employees, the company, and America, I would be honored to answer these calls and return as CEO.” Huang also said he “did not live up to the standards expected of everyone at NVIDIA, and I have made serious mistakes in my personal life.” “I created problems for the Board that I deeply regret,” he said. “I own my mistakes completely, and I am committed to cooperating with the Board’s independent investigation.” A portion of the statement was first reported by The Wall Street Journal, prompting shares of Nvidia to erase their earlier losses. Earlier Tuesday, Republicans announced that Huang had agreed to sit for an interview with several House committees about whether the computer chip giant’s sales to China may have endangered U.S. national security. items.t: Nvidia Growth Guidance Is Pivotal Point to Watch, Luria Says
items.d: Gil Luria, head of technology research at DA Davidson, explains why growth guidance is the main point to watch for in Nvidia’s earnings call after the bell Tuesday. He says it would be “more alarming” if the company has to pull growth guidance today, as it would be ‘a big leg down’ for the stock. He speaks on Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.t: Banks Pause $480 Million Chip Loan Tied to China’s ByteDance
items.d: The latest US curbs on access to its AI chips have frozen work on a $480 million loan to purchase advanced Nvidia Corp. hardware that would be used by Chinese technology giant ByteDance, according to people familiar with the matter.

items.fullText: 핫픽! 미국주식 핫픽! 미국주식 '젠슨 황'없는 엔비디아 첫 실적…하루 448조원 움직일수도 입력 2026.11.17 23:25 수정 2026.11.17 23:51 기사 스크랩 기사 스크랩 댓글 댓글 기사 공유 공유 글자크기 조절 글자크기 프린트 프린트 김정아 기자 구독하기 구글 검색 선호 출처로 추가 Google 검색에서 한국경제 기사를 더 자주 볼 수 있습니다. AI 기사요약 엔비디아가 젠슨 황 CEO의 사임 여파로 주가 급락을 겪은 가운데, 실적 발표를 앞두고 옵션 시장에서 약 8.5%의 대규모 주가 변동성이 예상되며 향후 AI 수요 전망에 시장의 관심이 집중되고 있습니다. 옵션시장,실적발표후 주가 상하변동폭 8.5% 예상 10월 이후 시가총액 약 2조달러 증발 월가,AI인프라 수요 지속여부와 향후 수요전망에 촉각 사진=REUTERS 미국 현지시간으로 17일 뉴욕 증시 마감후 발표되는 엔비디아의 실적 발표후 옵션 거래자들은 엔비디아 주가가 양방향으로 8.5% 변동할 것으로 예상했다. 이는 금액으로는 약 3,350억달러(약 448조원)에 달한다. 엔비디아 주가는 지난주 젠슨 황 CEO가 중국 스파이 혐의자 및 회사 부하 직원과의 불륜 의혹으로 사임한 이후 급락했다. 현재 이사회를 중심으로 후임 CEO를 찾는 동안, 최고재무책임자(CFO)인 콜레트 크레스가 임시 CEO를 맡고 있다. 그가 이 날 실적 발표를 진행할 것으로 예상된다. 무료 열람 혜택으로 기사를 읽으셨습니다. 한경 프리미엄9을 구독하고 무제한으로 만나보세요. 구독하기 한경 프리미엄9의 모든 콘텐츠는 한국경제신문의 저작물로 저작권법의 보호를 받습니다. 사전 허가 없는 무단 전재·복제·배포·캡처 공유·AI 학습 활용 및 상업적 이용을 금합니다. 위반 시 서비스 이용 제한 및 민형사상 법적 책임이 발생할 수 있습니다. AI 뉴스 Q&A 더 궁금한 점이 있으신가요? 읽으면서 머릿속에 맴돌던 질문들, 앨리스가 대답해 드릴게요. 인공지능(AI)을 활용해 생성되었으며, 일부 내용에 오류가 있을 수 있습니다. AI 포인트 뷰 이전 분석 종목 다음 분석 종목 본 서비스의 AI가 제공하는 종목 정보는 정보 제공 목적의 참고 자료일 뿐, 투자 권유·자문·추천에 해당하지 않습니다. 투자에 따른 손실 책임은 사용자에게 있습니다. 좋아요 싫어요 후속기사 원해요 김정아 객원기자 기자로 14년, 자본시장에서 18년 일했습니다. 글로벌 기업과 자본시장을 주시하고 있습니다. 기사댓글 개의 댓글이 있습니다. 댓글 닫기

items.fullText: Ian Buck Kicks Off NVIDIA’s Week at SC26 as Science Enters the Age of Agents At SC26, NVIDIA’s VP of Hyperscale and HPC laid out how researchers can combine simulation, AI and agents to accelerate scientific discovery. November 17, 2026 by Brian Caulfield 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! NVIDIA’s Ian Buck kicked off the company’s week at SC26 in Chicago on Monday with new tools for AI agents, software that can plan experiments, run code and check results on researchers’ own systems. In NVIDIA’s special address, Buck announced Nemotron for Science , the Rubin HPC GPU and an expanded Vera CPU platform for high-performance computing . He also detailed a new collaboration in quantum computing with IBM and Fermi National Accelerator Laboratory . “The frontier of computing and the new scientific stack is going to be simulation, as always, but combined with AI and the future of quantum,” said Buck, vice president of hyperscale and high-performance computing at NVIDIA. Buck opened the talk by looking back to his first public talk on CUDA, at an SC06 tutorial in Tampa, Florida, 20 years ago. NVIDIA now offers more than 1,000 CUDA-X libraries , he said. Open Models for Science Agents “[Agents] have been just a game changer in how we interface with our supercomputers, with our devices, our instruments and how we can do the research,” Buck said. Simulation remains the foundation of scientific computing, “which will always be on the top,” Buck said, with AI, quantum and now agents working alongside it. Nemotron for Science combines the Nemotron 3.5 Super VL open model with a new open chemistry dataset and post-training recipes for life sciences and chemistry, Buck explained. Researchers can run it locally on a DGX Spark, a workstation or their own supercomputer. items.t: EM Stocks Retreat Ahead of Nvidia, While Currencies Gain Ground

items.t: "돈 벌려고 불법판매했나"…美 압박에 엔비디아 'AI칩 판매 감시' 강화
items.fullText: 핫픽! 미국주식 핫픽! 미국주식 "돈 벌려고 불법판매했나"…美 압박에 엔비디아 'AI칩 판매 감시' 강화 입력 2026.11.17 20:31 수정 2026.11.17 20:52 기사 스크랩 기사 스크랩 댓글 댓글 기사 공유 공유 글자크기 조절 글자크기 프린트 프린트 김정아 기자 구독하기 구글 검색 선호 출처로 추가 Google 검색에서 한국경제 기사를 더 자주 볼 수 있습니다. 이사회에 '국가안보 및 수출 통제 감독 위원회'구성 베선트재무, 엔비디아 내부통제 강하게 비판 사진=REUTERS 엔비디아는 AI칩 등 이 회사의 제품 판매와 관련, 국가 안보 및 수출 통제를 감독하기 위한 새로운 위원회를 이사회에 구성했다. 미국 정부가 중국 기업의 동남아시아 데이터센터에 대한 고성능 칩 판매 규제를 강화하는 새 규정을 발표했고, 베선트 재무장관이 엔비디아의 내부통제가 느슨했다고 비판한 것도 영향을 미친 것으로 보인다. 17일(현지시간) 블룸버그에 따르면 엔비디아는 이 날 새로운 국가 안보 및 수출 통제 감독을 위한 위원회를 구성한다고 발표했다. 이 위원회는 이사회 멤버이자 전 골드만삭스 임원인 수잔 노라 존슨이 위원장을 맡고, 스티븐 닐과 존 다비리 두 명의 이사가 추가로 참여한다. 새 위원회 구성은 지난주 젠슨 황 전 CEO가 중국 스파이 용의자와의 불륜을 시인하며 사임한 후 임시 CEO로 임명된 콜레트 크레스가 단행한 첫 번째 큰 변화이다. 스콧 베선트 재무장관은 지난 15일 폭스뉴스와의 인터뷰에서 "엔비디아가 매출과 이익을 위해 불법적 판매를 강행했는지 묻고 싶다”며 “이사회와 외부 법률 고문으로부터 10일 안에 답변을 들어야 한다고 생각한다”며 엔비디아를 압박했다. 젠슨 황의 불륜 상대가 싱가포르 데이터센터업체 대표로 알려지면서 중국 기술 기업들이 엔비디아의 최첨단 AI칩을 동남아시아 데이터센터를 통해 우회 사용해온 관행이 드러났다. 이에 따라 엔비디아의 허술한 내부통제에 대한 비난이 높아졌다. 엔비디아는 17일 장 마감후 실적을 발표한다. 그러나 지난 주 황 CEO의 해임 이후 장기 전망에 대한 의문이 제기되면서 월가에서는 회사 실적 자체에 대한 관심이 떨어진 상태이다. 황 CEO의 불륜 사실이 폭로된 11월 8일 이후 엔비디아 주가는 16% 하락했다. 김정아 객원기자 kja@hankyung.com 무료 열람 혜택으로 기사를 읽으셨습니다. 한경 프리미엄9을 구독하고 무제한으로 만나보세요. 구독하기 한경 프리미엄9의 모든 콘텐츠는 한국경제신문의 저작물로 저작권법의 보호를 받습니다. 사전 허가 없는 무단 전재·복제·배포·캡처 공유·AI 학습 활용 및 상업적 이용을 금합니다. 위반 시 서비스 이용 제한 및 민형사상 법적 책임이 발생할 수 있습니다. AI 뉴스 Q&A 더 궁금한 점이 있으신가요? 읽으면서 머릿속에 맴돌던 질문들, 앨리스가 대답해 드릴게요. 인공지능(AI)을 활용해 생성되었으며, 일부 내용에 오류가 있을 수 있습니다. AI 포인트 뷰 이전 분석 종목 다음 분석 종목 본 서비스의 AI가 제공하는 종목 정보는 정보 제공 목적의 참고 자료일 뿐, 투자 권유·자문·추천에 해당하지 않습니다. 투자에 따른 손실 책임은 사용자에게 있습니다. 좋아요 싫어요 후속기사 원해요 김정아 객원기자 기자로 14년, 자본시장에서 18년 일했습니다. 글로벌 기업과 자본시장을 주시하고 있습니다. 기사댓글 개의 댓글이 있습니다. 댓글 닫기

items.t: "매디슨 황, 사실상 비서실장"…젠슨 황 퇴진 후 권한 시험대
items.fullText: 테크 한경 PREMIUM9 AI를 넘어서는 성공투자 구독하기 AI 추천 뉴스 AI 추천 뉴스 팝업 닫기 "매디슨 황, 사실상 비서실장"…젠슨 황 퇴진 후 권한 시험대 입력 2026.11.17 11:46 수정 2026.11.17 11:46 기사 스크랩 기사 스크랩 댓글 댓글 기사 공유 공유 글자크기 조절 글자크기 프린트 프린트 김소연 기자 구독하기 구글 검색 선호 출처로 추가 Google 검색에서 한국경제 기사를 더 자주 볼 수 있습니다. NYT, 전·현직 임직원 인용해 경영진 갈등 보도 젠슨 황 엔비디아 최고경영자(CEO)의 장녀인 매디슨 황 엔비디아 수석이사 /사진=뉴스1 젠슨 황 전 엔비디아 최고경영자(CEO)의 딸 매디슨 황이 공식 직책을 넘어 사실상 아버지의 비서실장 역할을 하며 경영진과 갈등을 빚어왔다고 뉴욕타임스(NYT)가 보도했다. NYT는 16일(현지시간) 전·현직 임직원 10여명을 인용해 매디슨 황 피지컬 AI 부문 제품 마케팅 수석이사가 직함과 관계없이 회사 주요 의사결정과 대외 메시지에 상당한 영향력을 행사했다고 전했다. 피지컬 AI는 로봇이나 자율주행 시스템처럼 현실 세계에서 주변 환경을 인식하고 움직이는 AI다. 매디슨의 공식 업무는 이 분야 제품 마케팅이지만, 실제로는 경영진 분기 회의와 이사회 발표, 마케팅·홍보 전략 등에 폭넓게 관여했다는 게 게 NYT의 보도 내용이다. 황 전 CEO의 가족 가운데는 매디슨 외에 아들 스펜서 황 로봇공학 제품 관리 이사, 사위인 니코 카프레즈 부사장도 엔비디아에서 일해왔다. 엔비디아는 과거 공시에서 황 전 CEO의 자녀들이 재직하고 있지만 "CEO와 동거하지 않으며, 당사의 임원도 아니고, CEO에게 직접 보고하는 관계도 아니다"라고 밝혔다. 여기서 임원은 미국 공시상 '집행임원'(executive officer)을 뜻하는 것으로, 사내 직급인 이사·수석이사와는 구분된다. NYT는 매디슨이 공식 보고 체계와 별개로 아버지의 대외 활동과 가족의 이미지 관리에 깊숙이 관여했다고 설명했다. 위기관리 전문업체 헬러를 고용해 황 전 CEO와 가족의 홍보를 지원하고, 지난해 10월 NYT가 엔비디아와 싱가포르 데이터센터 기업 메가스피드의 거래, 황 전 CEO와 앨리스 황의 관계를 보도했을 때도 홍보팀에 강력한 반박을 촉구하고 헬러의 지원을 받도록 했다는 것이다. 매디슨은 황 전 CEO 퇴진 이후 임시 CEO를 맡은 콜레트 크레스 최고재무책임자(CFO)와도 갈등을 빚었다고 NYT는 보도했다. 자신이 추진한 로봇 기업 투자와 남편 카프레즈 부사장이 맡은 데이터센터 기업들과의 거래가 대립의 배경으로 지목됐다. 차기 CEO 후보로 거론되는 이언 벅 부사장과의 충돌도 전해졌다. 올해 개발자 콘퍼런스 GTC를 앞두고 벅 부사장이 기자 브리핑용 발표 자료를 별도로 준비하지 않았다는 이유로 매디슨이 홍보팀 앞에서 소리를 질렀다는 것이다. 황 전 CEO의 측근이던 제이 푸리 부사장 역시 매디슨과 고성이 오가는 다툼을 벌인 뒤 기존 직책에서 물러나 수석고문으로 이동했다고 덧붙였다. 직원들은 최근 수년간 매디슨과 함께 일하는 데 불만을 느낀 주요 임원 12명가량이 회사를 떠났다고 추정했다. 인사 부서는 매디슨에게 경영 방식에 관한 코칭을 받도록 조치하기도 했다고 NYT는 보도했다. 매디슨이 추진한 마케팅 중에는 황 전 CEO를 만화 캐릭터로 만든 '토이 젠슨'도 있었다. 엔비디아는 GTC에서 해당 캐릭터가 그려진 스웨터를 178달러(약 24만원)에 판매하고, 캐릭터가 노래하는 영상도 상영했다. 직원들 사이에서는 창업자 개인을 지나치게 부각해 회사가 사이비 종교단체처럼 비칠 수 있다는 우려가 나왔다고 신문은 전했다. 엔비디아는 황 전 CEO가 혼외관계를 시인한 뒤 이 마케팅을 중단했다. 다만 아들 스펜서에 대한 평가는 다른 상황이다. 소식통들은 그가 조용한 성격으로 자신이 맡은 업무에 집중해왔다고 전했다. 한편 엔비디아는 지난 12일 황 전 CEO의 사임과 크레스 CFO의 임시 CEO 선임

items.t: 젠슨황·앤트로픽·금리…'삼중고'에 짓눌린 코스피
items.d: (서울=연합뉴스) 임은진 기자 = 젠슨 황 스캔들, 앤트로픽 상장, 미국 국채 금리.

items.t: 머스크는 62점, 젠슨 황은 90점?…18세 공대생의 채점표 화제
items.fullText: 테크 한경 PREMIUM9 AI를 넘어서는 성공투자 구독하기 AI 추천 뉴스 AI 추천 뉴스 팝업 닫기 머스크는 62점, 젠슨 황은 90점?…18세 공대생의 채점표 화제 입력 2026.11.17 10:13 수정 2026.11.17 10:21 기사 스크랩 기사 스크랩 댓글 댓글 기사 공유 공유 글자크기 조절 글자크기 프린트 프린트 허진 기자 구독하기 구글 검색 선호 출처로 추가 Google 검색에서 한국경제 기사를 더 자주 볼 수 있습니다. 젠슨 황 90%, 일론 머스크 62% 해외 공대생 만든 ‘빅테크 채점표’ 화제 프랑스 18세 공대생이 만든 아카이빙 인기 일론 머스크 영상 650여개 등 자료 총망라 ‘거친 입’ 머스크의 약속 이행률도 분석도 인기 커지자 ‘불륜 스캔들’ 젠슨 황도 추가 실리콘밸리 웹사이트 캡처 “올해 안에 완전자율주행(FSD)이 완성될 겁니다.” “몇 년 안에 화성에 도시를 건설하겠습니다.” 파격적인 비전과 예측으로 전 세계 테크 업계를 들썩이게 하는 일론 머스크 테슬라 최고경영자(CEO). 하지만 그가 내뱉은 수많은 공약과 예측 중 과연 몇 개나 실제로 지켜졌을까. 이 원초적인 호기심을 빅데이터와 아카이빙으로 풀어낸 웹사이트가 글로벌 테크 커뮤니티에서 폭발적인 화제를 모으고 있다. 주인공은 자신을 18세의 프랑스 공대생 기욤 보(Guillaume Baud)라고 소개한다. 그가 개발한 아카이빙 사이트 ‘실리콘밸리’는 머스크가 1998년 이후 진행한 인터뷰와 팟캐스트, 콘퍼런스, 제품 발표회, 테슬라 실적 콘퍼런스콜 등 방대한 발언 데이터를 총망라했다. 등록된 영상만 650개가 넘고, 재생 시간으로 환산하면 500시간을 훌쩍 넘는다. 주제별 분률부터 '공약 이행 성적표'도 실리콘밸리 웹사이트 캡처 이 사이트의 가장 큰 특징은 방대한 발언을 출산율·인구, 표현의 자유, 인공지능(AI) 등 주제별로 정교하게 분류해 한눈에 살펴볼 수 있다는 점이다. 그중에서도 테크 업계와 투자자들의 눈길을 가장 사로잡는 대목은 단연 ‘약속(Promises)’ 카테고리다. 보 씨는 머스크가 그간 대중 앞에서 내뱉은 수많은 발언과 예측, 공약을 추적해 실제 이행 여부를 냉정하게 평가했다. 머스크가 대중적 신뢰와 인기를 얻은 비결은 과감한 예측과 이를 현실로 만들어내는 불도저 같은 실행력에 있다. 그러나 일각에선 정교한 검증 없이 뱉어내는 잦은 실언과 과장 섞인 ‘아무 말’에 대한 비판도 끊이지 않았다. “팔콘 헤비가 2013년에 첫 비행을 한다”거나 “2017년까지 테슬라가 운전자의 조작 없이 LA에서 뉴욕까지 완주할 것”이라는 예측 등이 그 대표적인 사례다. 사이트에 따르면 머스크가 지금까지 내뱉은 공식적인 공약과 예측은 총 446개에 달한다. 이 중 기한이 명시된 약속은 163개이며, 이 중 실제로 지켜진 것은 101개로 단순 이행률은 62%를 기록했다. ‘약속한 기한 내에 정확히 지켰는지’로 범위를 좁히면 이행률은 39%로 뚝 떨어진다. 여기에 명확한 기한을 명시하지 않은 채 던진 수많은 발언까지 고려하면 체감 이행률은 이보다 훨씬 낮아진다는 분석이다. 인기 끌자 젠슨 황 추가 실리콘밸리 웹사이트 캡처 이 웹사이트가 선풍적인 인기를 끌며 주목을 받자, 보 씨는 분석 대상을 다른 빅테크 거물들로 확장하기 시작했다. ‘AI 시대의 황제’로 불렸다 최근 불륜 스캔들로 CEO 자리에서 내려 온 젠슨 황 엔비디아 전 CEO다. 사이트에 집계된 바에 따르면, 젠슨 황이 공개적으로 내놓은 예측과 공약은 총 70개다. 이 중 기한이 명시된 예측은 48개로, 이 가운데 43개가 실제로 실현돼 90%에 달하는 예측·이행률을 기록했다. 젠슨 황의 어긋난 약속에는 주로 자율주행 관련 내용이 많았다. 2017년 1월 그는 “엔비디아가 아

items.fullText: NVIDIA DGX Spark Developer Kit Turns a Desk Into a Supercomputing Lab November 16, 2026 by Allen Bourgoyne 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! At SC26, an annual supercomputing conference taking place this week in Chicago, NVIDIA is introducing the DGX Spark HPC Developer Kit for researchers, academics and developers. The kit is a four-node cluster of NVIDIA DGX Spark systems , each connected directly to its two neighbors in a ring, with an NVIDIA HPC SDK installation playbook coming soon. Researchers get a place at their desk to run multi-node scientific workloads, AI models and agents, instead of waiting for time on a shared GPU cluster. The kit puts the GB10 Grace Blackwell Superchip on researchers’ desks. A Supercomputing Lab on Any Desk The DGX Spark Developer Kit changes how researchers work. Read All NVIDIA Announcements From SC26 It scales from one system, or node, to four — linked directly to one another over NVIDIA ConnectX-7 networking, with no network switch to buy or set up. At four nodes, it provides 512GB of combined memory and 20TB of NVMe storage that provides researchers more capacity to distribute models and scientific workloads across the cluster. With NVFP4, researchers can deploy models with up to 700B parameters locally across the four DGX Spark clusters, such as DeepSeek V4.1. With that much power at the desk, researchers with a fixed compute and server allocation no longer have to wait in a queue for every job. Teams can develop and debug on their own, saving server hours for production runs and keeping unpublished results, and proprietary datasets on premises. The playbook for NVIDIA HPC SDK is coming soon, bringing GPU-accelerated C, C++ and Fortran compilers, libraries and message passing interface tools to the DGX Spark cluster — the same development tools used on NVIDIA-powered supercomputers. items.fullText: How the World’s Most Advanced AI Infrastructure Supply Chain Invents the Future Over two decades running the most complex manufacturing on the planet, NVIDIA operations chief Deb Shoquist has required three things of every supply chain partner: extreme technical skill, unshakeable trust and a willingness to always try something new. November 16, 2026 by NVIDIA Writers 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Deb Shoquist leads operations at NVIDIA, overseeing the supply chain and manufacturing behind its AI platforms. That description sums up the job, but it doesn’t begin to encompass what Shoquist has made possible over decades. Shoquist, her team and their global network of manufacturing partners enable NVIDIA to introduce world-leading technologies year-round. Much of the team’s success comes down to her deep relationships with some of the world’s most accomplished manufacturers, including TSMC, Foxconn, Wistron, SPIL, King Yuan Electronics (KYEC), Unimicron, Lumentum, Coherent and Amkor. TSMC has partnered with NVIDIA since 1998. SPIL and KYEC were assembling and testing its chips more than two decades ago. For Shoquist, those relationships grow stronger through each challenge solved together on the factory floor, as every generation of technology demands more from the people and tools behind it. Ask her about the global network she relies on, and she starts with the people. There’s the supplier in Taiwan so eager to get production moving that he calls her at 3 a.m. with a fix to the latest problem. There are the factory workers in Vietnam whose only ask of her are more tools to get more work done. She remembers the partners that supported NVIDIA when it was small, and the work they’ve done to help each other grow. Shoquist meets with key suppliers quarterly and spends six weeks each year on the road visiting partners in Taiwan, China, Korea, Vietnam and the U.S., where conversations move from meeting rooms to factory floors

items.fullText: Lambda Boosts AI Factory Resiliency and Efficiency With NVIDIA Photonics November 16, 2026 by Brian Sparks 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! To train an AI model, thousands of GPUs have to work together, requiring a network that’s fast, efficient and resilient. Lambda is tackling the network piece of the puzzle with NVIDIA Photonics co-packaged optics (CPO) switches. The cloud provider is using the switches to connect NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 racks with more than 10,000 GPUs, delivering lower power, higher resiliency and longer mean time between interruptions (MTBI) to an AI factory at scale. “Networking has to keep pace with the demands of increasingly large AI clusters,” said Dave Ward, president of cloud services at Lambda. “Bringing co-packaged optics into a deployment of this scale is an important step toward building the infrastructure needed to support the next generation of AI.” Read All NVIDIA Announcements From SC26 In the company’s tests using the switches, network latency — the time needed for moving data — dropped by about 4% at rack scale and by up to about 10% at pod scale. Across rack, scalable unit and pod configurations, the network maintains the same throughput as conventional pluggable optics. Delivering Power Efficiency and Resiliency at Scale Improving power efficiency and resiliency matters because the network sits at the center of AI factory productivity. In a large training job, one interrupted link can stall thousands of GPUs. With agentic inference, one network disruption can introduce cascading latency effects on many agents. Every interruption costs time, and every watt spent on networking is a watt not available for compute. NVIDIA Photonics addresses both power efficiency and resiliency. By replacing pluggable transceivers with co-packaged optical engines on the switch package, it delivers up to 5x better power efficiency and up to 15x higher reliability than conventional pluggable optics. items.fullText: NVIDIA Expands Slurm to Bring Quantum Computing Into Supercomputing Quantum hardware developers, software providers and supercomputing centers are adopting the community-built Slurm workloads manager and the NVIDIA quantum platform to integrate quantum processors, design future systems and develop scientific applications. November 16, 2026 by Sam Stanwyck 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Quantum processor deployments at supercomputing centers have grown nearly sevenfold over the past five years, with nearly 30 supercomputing centers around the world now in the process of deploying over 50 quantum processors. Many of these centers use Slurm to run scientific supercomputing workloads, so expanding its support for quantum processors builds on familiar workflows and tools, enabling computational chemists, nuclear physicists and materials scientists to bring quantum computing into their research domains without friction. In a new release, Slurm builds on previous work with IBM, Pasqal and the wider quantum computing community to allow QPU builders to create a single interface to their hardware for every supercomputing center, through a simple file. This makes it easier than ever for HPC centers and QPU builders to integrate and serve their hardware. The expansion is already being adopted by Alice & Bob , IBM , IQM , Pasqal , Quantinuum and MQSC and supports the widely used QRMI and QDMI interfaces. Read All NVIDIA Announcements From SC26 Beating the Bottleneck Until now, integrating a QPU into a supercomputing center meant a new software challenge for every new QPU or supercomputing center. By building on existing quantum-HPC interfaces such as QRMI and QDMI, the Slurm expansion allows QPU builders to reuse their integrations across all their deployments. items.fullText: NVIDIA Sweeps MLPerf Training and Endpoints as Vera Rubin Debuts With Leading Performance November 16, 2026 by Shruti Koparkar 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! In its MLPerf benchmarks debut, with results released today, the NVIDIA Vera Rubin platform delivers leading performance across training, post-training and agentic inference. NVIDIA swept every MLPerf Training v6.1 benchmark and, in its first MLPerf Endpoints submission, delivered more than 10x generational gains in throughput per watt for agentic AI — measuring how much agentic work a system delivers with each watt of power. These results are just the beginning. Vera Rubin performance will keep climbing through continuous optimization of NVIDIA’s CUDA-powered software stack , so the infrastructure that customers invest in today delivers more value over time. NVIDIA Sweeps MLPerf Training v6.1 AI agents are now everywhere, writing code, running business workflows, answering customer questions and, as this week’s SC26 conference highlights , advancing scientific research. Faster training means smarter agents can reach users sooner, drug discovery models can keep pace with new lab data and fraud-detection models can adapt to new threats faster. MLPerf Training measures how fast a system can train a range of AI models to a target level of accuracy. The NVIDIA platform was the only one with results on every benchmark this round, spanning large language models, image generation, recommender systems and reinforcement learning post-training. In its debut, Vera Rubin NVL72 delivered up to 2x more performance per GPU than the highly optimized NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 system — early results that show the pace of generation-over-generation innovation. items.fullText: NVIDIA CUDA-X Libraries Give Agents the Tools to Accelerate Scientific Discovery November 16, 2026 by Kibibi Moseley 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! With expanded NVIDIA CUDA-X libraries, including cuPhoton, cuPotential and cuSpa, researchers can sift through vast amounts of data to accelerate research, from astrophysics and materials science to single-cell biology. The speedups are helping scientists analyze larger datasets and model more complex systems. The new libraries give AI agents the tools to help researchers make discoveries faster than ever. Read All NVIDIA Announcements From SC26 Bringing Black Holes Into Focus Seeing a black hole takes a telescope the size of Earth. The Event Horizon Telescope links radio dishes worldwide, generating petabytes of data that can take months to process. With NVIDIA cuPhoton.xBeam, a module within the cuPhoton Toolkit , black hole observations from the Event Horizon Telescope can now be correlated orders of magnitude faster than ever. Analysis that once took over a month now takes eight minutes. By combining global radio dishes into Earth-sized aperture, cuPhoton delivers unprecedented astronomical imaging resolution. cuPhoton successfully correlated observations of powerful black hole jets J1924 and 3C279 in the night sky — making it a reality to reconstruct a Messier 87* black hole galaxy in real time. The entire pipeline, from data loading and processing to visualization, runs on distributed multi-GPU systems or a compact NVIDIA DGX Spark system, helping scientists study how gas spirals inward under a black hole’s powerful gravitational pull. Steering Fusion Simulations Sustaining plasma at millions of degrees is essential to achieving stable, continuous fusion energy. But simulating its behavior is costly: on petascale systems, a single time step can take days, with simulations running for weeks. items.fullText: CUDA at 20: How the Platform Transformed Scientific Computing Over two decades, CUDA, the platform that turned GPUs into the engine of modern science, has advanced Nobel Prize-winning research and more. November 16, 2026 by Brett Murray 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! This week at SC26, NVIDIA is marking two decades of CUDA by honoring the researchers, developers and engineers who helped make GPU computing a foundation for modern science and AI. CUDA’s 20th anniversary presents an occasion to reflect across computing eras, from the people who wrote the very first CUDA programs to the AI developers building on their work today. At the platform’s core is this developer community whose experiments, tools and persistence expanded what accelerated computing could do. From SC06 to SC26 NVIDIA announced CUDA in November 2006 and brought it to the scientific community at SC06, giving scientists and developers a familiar, high-level programming model for using GPUs. It fundamentally extended accelerated computing beyond graphics use cases to accelerate demanding applications for science, simulation and more. In the two decades since, developers have used CUDA to advance Nobel Prize-winning AI research , accelerate scientific applications on supercomputers and support visual effects in Oscar-winning films . Today, more than 11 million developers build on CUDA across the computing stack. items.fullText: NVIDIA Announces Rubin HPC — A New GPU to Accelerate Agents for Science, Engineering and Analytics A record leap in CUDA cores with accelerated data movement shorten time to results for science and engineering workloads. November 16, 2026 by Dan Ernst 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Announced today at SC26, NVIDIA Rubin HPC is a new GPU in the NVIDIA Vera Rubin platform designed to accelerate simulation and data processing for science, engineering and analytics workflows. As agents help scientists and engineers explore more candidate materials, molecules and designs, they rely on simulations to test those ideas and guide their next steps. Rubin HPC will accelerate those simulations, shortening the path from exploration to scientific discovery and industrial design. The Rubin HPC GPU features a record number of CUDA cores — more than 50,000 on a single GPU — as well as a sparse data acceleration capability that keeps those cores fed with data, and accelerates GPU-to-GPU connectivity with seventh-generation NVIDIA NVLink interconnect technology. Read All NVIDIA Announcements From SC26 Scientists and engineers rely on simulation to understand complex systems before committing to experiments or physical prototypes. Working with agents, these teams can explore more candidate materials, molecules and designs. This increases demand for the GPU-accelerated simulations needed to evaluate those ideas and guide next steps. “For agents tackling science and engineering, faster simulation means faster discovery,” said Ian Buck , vice president of hyperscale and high-performance computing at NVIDIA. “Rubin HPC accelerates the simulations agents use to test ideas and guide their next steps, helping scientists and engineers explore more possibilities and bring breakthroughs closer.” Turning Faster Computation Into Faster Discovery Across climate models, engineering simulations, genomic analysis and financial risk, scientific computing w

Over two days at COEX, more than 2,000 attendees converged for AI Day Seoul, bringing together Korea’s industry leaders, startups and developer communities advancing physical AI and AI agents. At the plenary sessions, Deepu Talla, vice president of robotics and edge AI at NVIDIA, said Korea is “punching above its weight,” with Doosan Robotics, Hyundai Motor Group, LG Electronics and SK Group — as well as startups like Real World and Luda Robotics — using NVIDIA platforms to bring general-purpose robotics into the real world. Jonathan Cohen, vice president of applied research at NVIDIA, showed how enterprises can build agents they own and control. Breakout sessions featured speakers from Coupang Intelligent Cloud, Doosan Robotics, LG AI Research, LG Electronics, NAVER Cloud, SK Telecom and Upstage. “It was a genuinely enjoyable time to have candid conversations,” said Hyunho Yang, research engineer for omnimodal foundation models at SK Telecom. “Seeing the passion of fellow AI developers was a real source of inspiration for me.” Community leaders share how they build with open models and tools at AI Day Seoul. The Agentic AI 10x Bootcamp Community Day brought together Pseudo Lab, Python Korea, PyTorchKR, HAERAE, Hugging Face KREW, Graph User Group, Womxn Who Code Korea, Dnol (Datayanolja) and other developer communities. Five finalists from the Hangul Day hackathon, co-hosted with Fastcampus, built agents trained on the Korean language and culture with the OpenShell runtime. The winning team, FlyGate, received an NVIDIA DGX Spark system. More than 500 developers also took part in full-day NVIDIA Deep Learning Institute workshops and NVIDIA Certification exams in Korean. items.t: The rise and fall of former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang
items.d: Jensen Huang, who once led the most valuable company in the world, resigned from his post as Nvidia CEO today after an affair with a suspected Chinese spy. Huang had co-founded Nvidia in 1993, and it became a juggernaut making the chips underpinning much of the AI boom.

Launching on Steam Thursday, Dec. 3, the real-time strategy game returns to the series’ roots with large-scale battles, base building and a renewed fight for planet Kronus. Command the Space Marines, Orks, Necrons or the Adeptus Mechanicus, which makes their series debut. Build a base, secure resources and customize squads to the conflict across more than 70 campaign missions, playable solo or in co-op mode. The Last Stand, Skirmish and multiplayer modes offer more ways to put tactics to the test. GeForce NOW will bring the action to supported PCs, Macs, handhelds and other devices, with game downloads and updates handled in the cloud. Save the storage space for everyday essentials and planning for the next offensive. Wishlist the game on Steam , and stay tuned to GFN Thursday to prepare for launch. items.fullText: NVIDIA Expands Open Source Commitment With OpenShell Contribution and New AI Infrastructure At KubeCon, NVIDIA is putting tools to secure agents and run AI on Kubernetes in the hands of the cloud-native community. November 10, 2026 by Warren Barkley 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Kubernetes, the open source system that manages how applications run across thousands of AI factories, has become the foundation for AI, and the demands on it are only growing. To help meet them, NVIDIA is deepening its commitment to open source at KubeCon + CloudNativeCon , the flagship conference for the Kubernetes and cloud-native communities. NVIDIA is contributing NVIDIA OpenShell , an open source runtime for securing and governing autonomous agents, to the Cloud Native Computing Foundation (CNCF), a nonprofit that is part of the Linux Foundation and the host of KubeCon. As a CNCF Sandbox project, OpenShell will be governed by the organizations building it into their products and strengthened by the expertise of security professionals worldwide. NVIDIA is also contributing to Agent Substrate , an open source Google-led framework for operating long-running agent workloads at scale on Kubernetes that has been accepted into the CNCF Sandbox. Additionally, NVIDIA announced new components of the NVIDIA DSX AI Factory Platform : NVIDIA Kubernetes Engine , NVIDIA Kubernetes Recipes and NVIDIA Snapshot . These tools help teams deploy, manage and scale GPU infrastructure on Kubernetes for AI factories. Together, these advancements mark a step forward in making Kubernetes the leading foundation for AI workloads at scale — empowering developers to build safer, more efficient AI infrastructure for the future. items.fullText: Practice Makes Precise: At CoRL, NVIDIA and Partners Reveal How Robots Rehearse Delicate Work in Simulation At the Conference on Robot Learning, NVIDIA is introducing GR00T 2, Isaac Lab 3.0 and new open benchmarks, built in collaboration with partners, bringing precision and scale to robot training. November 9, 2026 by Sasa Docca 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Simulation, which has long been the proving ground for robots learning to walk, roll and hop, is now helping researchers teach robots tasks that require a finer touch: aligning gears, connecting cables and assembling small components. The shift from locomotion to manipulation is taking center stage at this week’s Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL) in Austin, Texas, alongside the rise of agentic robotics — a new paradigm that integrates frontier agents to create interpretable code for physical robotics systems. At CoRL, NVIDIA is introducing new open robotics technologies, including world action models , simulation tools, benchmarks and agentic workflows. Two NVIDIA papers are among six finalists out of thousands of submissions for the Best Paper Awards at CoRL: GRAIL (Generating Humanoid Loco-Manipulation from World Models), which presents a digital generation pipeline for 3D assets and simulator-ready scenes for robot learning. RoboTTT: Context Scaling for Robot Policies , which introduces a robot model and training recipe that scales visuomotor context three orders of magnitude beyond state-of-the-art policies without growing inference latency. These advancements help researchers train robots on complex tasks, evaluate their performance across changing conditions and use failures to guide further learning — building the precision, adaptability and autonomy needed to move from lab demonstrations to industrial deployment. items.fullText: NVIDIA Announces New Planned Investments in Korean Startups at the MSIT-NVIDIA AI Startup Partnership Forum November 9, 2026 by NVIDIA Writers 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Korea’s Ministry of Science and ICT and NVIDIA hosted the MSIT -NVIDIA AI Startup Partnership Forum at COEX. Representatives from the Ministry of Science and ICT and NVIDIA met with over 20 Korean startups across foundation models, physical AI, AI infrastructure and AI semiconductors. NVIDIA also announced an investment in Korean startup Point2 , with additional investments planned in Motif Technologies , RLWRLD and Upstage. Point2 Technology, an AI interconnect company, builds scalable, radio frequency-based interconnects that move data between chips and racks in AI factories, offering an innovative alternative to conventional copper and optical interconnect solutions for AI cluster scale-up, delivering the reach, performance and efficiency needed for next-generation AI infrastructure. Motif Technologies , a Seoul-based AI lab, develops foundation models for building AI agents that carry out complex tasks, including Motif-3, a large language model released with open weights. RLWRLD, a physical AI startup based in San Francisco, Seoul and Tokyo, develops robotics foundation models that enable humanoid and industrial robots to perform complex real-world tasks that require five-finger dexterity, such as precisely inserting components, threading nuts onto bolts and kitting parts from moving conveyors. Upstage , a Korean enterprise AI company, develops Solar language models and document AI tools that help businesses extract information from complex documents, streamline workflows and build AI applications for everyday operations. The companies represent work across the full AI stack , from infrastructure to models to robotics applications. items.fullText: Korea Advances Physical AI Across Industries With NVIDIA November 8, 2026 by NVIDIA Writers 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Tapping into the country’s strengths in manufacturing and engineering, NVIDIA is helping advance Korea’s physical AI ecosystem. The country’s industry leaders are applying accelerated computing, AI and simulation to everything from semiconductor manufacturing to robotics and autonomous vehicles. These efforts are helping bring physical AI from development into real-world production. Samsung Advances Semiconductor Engineering With Accelerated Computing and AI Physics Samsung Electronics is expanding its collaboration with NVIDIA to advance semiconductor innovation through accelerated computing and AI physics. The work spans materials research, process development and device engineering. In technology computer-aided design, Samsung is working with NVIDIA cuISS and NVIDIA cuDSS to accelerate computations involving sparse linear systems. The collaboration also extends to GPU acceleration for process and optical simulations. In materials research, Samsung’s sMOL platform has run selected quantum chemical calculations up to 5x faster end to end with NVIDIA cuEST . Samsung is also exploring NVIDIA cuEquivariance to speed up tensor operations used in training and inference for atomistic AI models. Samsung is developing chip-scale thermal and mechanical analysis workflows with NVIDIA PhysicsNeMo . In one AI homogenization case, combining AI-predicted effective material properties, coarser grids and GPU acceleration resulted in a roughly 1,600x speedup. Simulation time fell from about 18 hours for a fine-grid solve on a 32-core CPU to 41 seconds for a GPU-accelerated coarse-grid solve. Looking ahead, NVIDIA Agent Toolkit could connect these simulation tools and AI models, helping future engineering agents run analyses and compare design options.
